question: Which of the following planets has the shortest rotation period?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jupiter.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The question asks for the planet with the shortest rotation period, which means the planet that rotates the fastest.**
 
• **Jupiter** is the correct answer as it rotates the fastest among the given options with a period of 9.9 Earth hours.
 
• **Mercury** has a longer rotation period than Jupiter, while Mars has a similar rotation period to Earth.
 
• **Venus has the slowest rotation period among the given options.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mercury**: It has a rotation period of **58.6 Earth days**, which is** longer** than its orbit around the sun.
 
• **Jupiter:** It has a rotation period of **9.9 Earth hours,** making it the **fastest rotating planet** in our solar system.
 
• **Mars:** It has a rotation period of **24.6 Earth hours,** which is similar to Earth's rotation period.
 
• **Venus:** It has a rotation period of** 243 Earth days**, making it the** slowest rotating planet** in our solar system.
